Indeed is the #1 job site in the world. More people get hired on Indeed than any other site. On Indeed, jobseekers and employers can: search for jobs, post resumes, research companies, compare salaries, get career advice, and more.

## Searching for jobs
Indeed Job Search works using one or more parameters:
q = Query, which is typically a job title, skill or contract type
l = Location, which can be a state, city, metro area, zipcode etc
fromage = Number of days since posted
radius = Miles search radius around a specified location

So a complete search can be constructed as:
https://[cc].indeed.com/jobs?q=[query]&l=[location]

Alternatively there are often canonical versions of these job search urls in search engine indexes such as Google and Bing e.g. https://ca.indeed.com/q-driver-l-austin,-tx-jobs.html

- nurse jobs in Toronto Cananda: https://ca.indeed.com/jobs?q=nurse&l=toronto
